title: Media import base64-encodes the whole file into a JSON body, so anything over ~75 MiB is refused and over ~384 MiB dies silently

summary: Diagnosed from a 474 MiB 4K/120 HEVC clip that imported as nothing: V8 max string length beats the bodyParser 100mb limit to it. Implementing the webUtils.getPathForFile path-copy fix.

Server half verified on an isolated instance with the real 474 MiB clip: byte-identical copy, full sidecar (3840x2160, 120fps, 91.282s, 2738 frames, audio), thumb + 720p proxy, 26.7s; both 400 guards fire and the base64 path still works. Remaining: one human drag-drop, which no agent can drive.
